title: 第 13 章 偶遇受难弟子顺手行善第 11 章 全网唾骂天道刻意抹黑
lines: 青玄宗月度议事大殿人声鼎沸，各峰长老按位次落座，内门天骄分列两侧，偌大殿堂气氛肃穆。苏辰早早站在偏位，一身素布青衫打理得干干净净，眉眼挂着恰到好处的温和笑意，暗中与提前串通的三名中层长老眼神交汇，一切尽在不言中。按照预先布局，只要议事流程走到资源调配环节，三名长老便会接连开口举荐，以培养宗门顶尖天才为由，申请从宗门库房划拨大批淬体丹、修炼灵石，苏辰再假意谦让几番，就能顺理成章白嫖海量修行资源。
陆衍没有着急立刻进入大殿，而是在殿外青石小道缓步停留。按照系统方才的提示，苏辰拿到资源之后，就要动身前往城郊幽谷，抢夺一处无主天然灵药机缘，那处机缘本是偶然诞生、无主之物，可苏靠着天命气运天然优先占有，属于系统划定的不义机缘范畴，同样是自己后续的制衡目标。他打算先不急着闯入议事堂撕破脸皮，暂且静观议事走向，顺便趁着空档在外门片区闲逛，继续积攒功德，一点点磨掉残留的天道厄运。
一旁跟随的赵小胖揣着厚厚的笔录册子，里面全是这些天搜集苏辰虚伪言行、暗中指使手下欺压弟子的各类证据，小胖憋了一路：“少爷，咱们直接进去把证据摆出来，当着所有长老的面揭穿他想空手套丹药的心思，让他美梦泡汤！”
陆衍摇摇头：“现在进去太早，苏还没正式开口索要资源，没有实锤动作，长老们受天道潜移默化影响，大概率只会觉得咱们蓄意诬告，反倒帮苏博取同情气运，得不偿失。等他当众开口提条件，再择机出手才是最优解。”
打发小胖守在大殿门外盯紧动向，一旦苏开始提资源申请就立刻传信，陆独自一人顺着外门低矮屋舍方向漫步而去。如今全宗门上下还处在天道制造的偏见里，绝大多数外门弟子撞见陆衍，要么慌忙躲开，要么低声窃骂阴险纨绔，陆全都视而不见，一心寻找行善积攒功德的契机。
沿着蜿蜒土路走到外门杂役居住的偏僻角落，一阵压抑的**声传入耳中。拐过矮矮的土墙，陆衍一眼看见一名身形瘦弱的少年蜷缩在荒草堆里，左腿经脉淤青肿胀，身上的粗布衣衫被撕扯出好几道破口，身边散落断裂的修行木剑，三名身着内门服饰的年轻弟子正叉腰围在一旁，嘴里骂骂咧咧。
这名少年名叫林安，此前在灵泉外围偶然撞见苏辰私底下克扣陆家下人月钱、动辄用修为威压欺负仆役，一时嘴碎和同伴随口聊了几句，这话辗转传到苏辰耳朵里。苏表面装作大度不放在心上，暗地里授意手下跟班找借口寻衅，借着琐事刻意刁难，不光当众殴打林安，还暗中动用微弱灵气震伤对方经脉，废掉一小部分修炼根基，让其短期内没法正常打坐修炼。
“就凭你一个没背景的寒门杂役，也敢随便议论苏师兄的是非？今天算是给你长长记性！”领头的内门弟子抬脚就要再次踹向林安的身体，旁边两名跟班在一旁哄笑起哄，四周围了十多名看热闹的外门弟子，所有人明明于心不忍，却没有一人敢上前阻拦。
不是众人冷漠无情，而是吃过亏的人不在少数，但凡上前帮林安说话，事后都会被苏的追随者刻意针对，要么被分配最差的修炼资源，要么莫名遭遇各种倒霉事，在天道隐性加持下，帮人就要惹祸，久而久之大家全都选择明哲保身，只敢远远围观。
眼看一脚即将落下，陆衍缓步上前出声制止：“同门修行，动辄动手伤人，不合宗门戒律。”
三名内门跟班转头瞧见陆衍，先是一愣，紧接着面露嚣张，在他们固有印象里，陆衍是蛮横跋扈的世家恶少，但现在全宗门人人都在踩陆，几人仗着背靠苏辰，压根没把陆家少主放在眼里。“原来是陆大纨绔，怎么闲着没事管我们的私事？难不成你还想替这个小人物出头？”领头弟子满脸讥讽，抬手还想摆出架势吓唬陆衍。
可他们哪里清楚，如今的陆衍早已稳固炼气巅峰修为，肉身被多**德灵气淬炼，修为远超普通内门弟子，对方的威慑落在陆身上如同儿戏。陆衍没有依仗家世骂人，也没有反手暴力报复三人，只是语气平淡点明规矩：“宗门律法明令禁止私斗伤人，打伤就要赔付疗伤丹药，你们打伤同门，拿出三枚低级疗伤丹，此事就此作罢。”
几人本想仗着苏的名头硬气顶撞，可刚刚抬手想要出手，就被陆衍轻飘飘一道灵气震得手臂发麻，整条胳膊酸软无力，瞬间认清实力差距，心不甘情不愿从储物袋摸出丹药扔在地上，带着满腹怨气狼狈逃窜。
地上的林安抬头，望着眼前的陆衍，满眼难以置信。大街小巷所有人都在传陆衍阴险歹毒、仗势欺人，是全宗门最不讲道理的纨绔，可眼前这人出手帮自己解围，还俯身捡起地上丹药递过来，紧接着指尖凝出一缕温润灵气，缓缓渡入林安受损的左腿经脉，帮其疏通淤塞的受损脉络，原本钻心的痛感飞速消退。
短短片刻功夫，林安受损经脉被稳住，原本废掉的一小部分根基被灵气稳住，不用再躺着休养数月。少年眼眶泛红，连连躬身作揖：“多谢公子救命之恩，我身无分文，没有宝物能够报答。”
陆摆了摆手，不留姓名，转身便打算离开，做好事不求回报，恰恰是系统判定良心奖励的关键条件。
就在转身瞬间，清脆的系统提示音在脑海接连响起。【叮！宿主路见不平出手救助被欺压无辜弟子，不索要任何报酬、不动私刑惩治跟班，符合良心判定，触发初级良心暴击！】【功德+126，体内残留天道厄运再次被大幅冲刷，修行顺畅度再度提升！】【零散善意口碑开始在附近外门弟子心中扎根，破除片面偏见的种子再度发芽。】
附近一众围观的外门弟子亲眼目睹全过程，先前根深蒂固的刻板印象悄然裂开一道缝隙，不少人暗自嘀咕：传闻和亲眼所见完全不一样，全网唾骂的恶少反倒出手救人，被万人追捧的苏师兄，却纵容手下随意伤人。零星的疑惑悄然在人群心里扎根，只是受天道干扰，没人敢当众说出自己的想法。
陆衍没多停留，辞别一众围观弟子，快步朝着议事大殿方向折返，刚走到半路，等候多时的赵小胖慌慌张张迎面跑来，急声道：“少爷，出事了！苏已经当着一众长老的面开口索要丹药，三名帮腔长老轮番说话，不少长老已经动心，眼看就要敲定资源划拨！”
陆衍眼神一凝，加快脚步赶往大殿，还没等踏入殿门，系统新提示忽然弹出。【紧急情报：苏拿到丹药资源后，即刻动身前往西郊黑风幽谷，抢占天然灵草机缘，那处灵草蕴含提纯灵气，是快速突破修为的绝佳宝物，属于天道定向馈赠的不义机缘，是下一个重点制衡目标。】

The Qingxuan Sect's monthly meeting hall was full of people. The elders of each peak took their seats in order, and the inner disciples were lined up on both sides. The atmosphere in the huge hall was solemn. Su Chen stood at a side position early, wearing a plain blue shirt and neatly groomed, with a gentle smile on his eyebrows. He secretly made eye contact with the three middle-level elders who had colluded in advance, and everything was unspoken. According to the pre-arranged plan, as soon as the discussion process reaches the resource allocation stage, the three elders will make recommendations one after another. On the grounds of cultivating the sect's top talents, they will apply for the allocation of a large number of body tempering pills and cultivation spirit stones from the sect's warehouse. If Su Chen pretends to be humble, he will be able to get a huge amount of cultivation resources for free.
Lu Yan did not rush to enter the hall immediately, but slowly stopped on the bluestone path outside the hall. According to the prompts from the system, after Su Chen obtained the resources, he was about to head to the deep valley on the outskirts of the city to seize an opportunity for an unowned natural elixir. That opportunity was born by chance and had no owner, but Su naturally took possession of it through destiny and luck. It fell into the category of unjust opportunities defined by the system, and was also the target of his own subsequent checks and balances. He planned not to rush into the meeting hall and quarrel with each other, but to wait and see how the proceedings went. He also took advantage of the free time to wander around the outer gate area, continue to accumulate merit, and gradually wear away the remaining misfortune of heaven.
Fatty Zhao, who was following him, carried a thick book of records, which was full of evidence collected over the past few days on Su Chen's false words and deeds, and secretly instigating his subordinates to bully his disciples. Fatty Zhao held it back all the way: "Master, let's go directly in and lay out the evidence, and expose his intention to get the pills in front of all the elders, so that his dream will be ruined!"
Lu Yan shook his head: "It's too early to go in now. Su hasn't formally asked for resources yet, and there are no concrete actions. The elders are influenced by the subtle influence of heaven. There is a high probability that we will only think that we are deliberately making false accusations. Instead, we will help Su Bo gain sympathy and luck. The gain outweighs the losses. Waiting for him to ask for conditions in public before choosing an opportunity to take action is the best solution."
He sent the chubby boy to wait outside the main hall to keep an eye on the situation, and send a message as soon as Su started to apply for resources. Lu walked alone in the direction of the low house outside the outer gate. Nowadays, the whole sect is still under the prejudice created by Heavenly Dao. When most of the outer sect disciples see Lu Yan, they either run away in a hurry or whisper about the insidious dude. Lu turns a blind eye and only looks for opportunities to do good deeds and accumulate merit.
Walking along the winding dirt road to a remote corner where the servants lived at the outer gate, a suppressed sound of gunshots reached my ears. Turning around the low earthen wall, Lu Yan saw a thin young man huddled in a pile of grass. His left leg was bruised and swollen. His coarse clothes were torn in several holes. Broken wooden practice swords were scattered around him. Three young disciples in inner sect clothes were standing around with their arms akimbo, cursing.
This young man's name was Lin An. He had accidentally encountered Su Chen secretly deducting monthly payments from the servants of the Lu family outside Lingquan, and often using his cultivation to bully the servants. He had a casual conversation with his companions, and these words reached Su Chen's ears. On the surface, Su pretended not to take it seriously, but secretly instructed his subordinates to find excuses to provoke and deliberately create difficulties through trivial matters. Not only did he beat Lin An in public, he also secretly used weak spiritual energy to shock the opponent's meridians, destroying a small part of his cultivation foundation, making it impossible for him to meditate normally in the short term.
"You, a humble servant with no background, dare to talk about Senior Brother Su casually? I'll give you a long memory today!" The leading inner disciple raised his foot and was about to kick Lin An's body again. The two followers next to him were laughing and making noises. There were more than a dozen outer disciples watching the fun. Everyone obviously couldn't bear it, but no one dared to step forward to stop him.
It's not that everyone is indifferent, but that there are many people who have suffered losses. Anyone who comes forward to speak for Lin An will be deliberately targeted by Su's followers afterwards. They will either be assigned the worst cultivation resources, or encounter all kinds of unlucky things for no reason. With the hidden blessing of heaven, helping others will cause trouble. Over time, everyone chooses to protect themselves and only dare to watch from a distance.
Seeing that the kick was about to fall, Lu Yan stepped forward slowly and stopped him: "We are practicing in the same sect, and it is against the sect's rules to hurt others at every turn."
The three inner sect followers turned around to see Lu Yan. They were stunned at first, and then showed arrogance. In their inherent impression, Lu Yan was a domineering and evil young man from a family, but now everyone in the sect was stepping on Lu. A few of them relied on Su Chen to support him, and did not take the young master of the Lu family seriously. "It turns out you are Lu Dan, why are you so busy meddling in our private affairs? Do you still want to stand up for this little guy?" The leading disciple was full of sarcasm, raising his hand to try to scare Lu Yan.
But how do they know that Lu Yan has already stabilized his peak level of Qi refining, his body has been tempered by the spiritual energy of many virtues, and his cultivation level is far beyond that of ordinary inner disciples. The intimidation of the other party is like child's play on Lu. Lu Yan did not rely on his family background to curse, nor did he backhand violently retaliate against the three people. He just stated the rules in a calm tone: "The sect's laws clearly prohibit private fighting and hurting others. If you are injured, you must pay for healing pills. If you hurt a fellow sect, take out three low-level healing pills, and let this matter be over."
Several people wanted to use Su's reputation to confront him, but just as they raised their hands to take action, Lu Yan's light energy shocked their arms, making them numb. Their whole arms were sore and weak. They instantly recognized the difference in strength, reluctantly took out the elixir from the storage bag and threw it on the ground, and ran away in embarrassment full of resentment.
Lin An, who was on the ground, raised his head and looked at Lu Yan in front of him, his eyes full of disbelief. Everyone in the streets and alleys were saying that Lu Yan was sinister, vicious, bullying, and the most unreasonable playboy in the entire sect. However, the man in front of him came to help him out, and even leaned down to pick up the pills on the ground and handed them over. Then a wisp of warm aura condensed from his fingertips, and slowly passed into Lin An's damaged left leg meridians, helping him clear the blocked and damaged meridians, and the original heartbreaking pain quickly subsided.
In just a few moments, Lin An's damaged meridians were stabilized, and a small part of the foundation that was originally destroyed was stabilized by spiritual energy, eliminating the need to lie down and recuperate for several months. The young man's eyes were red, and he bowed repeatedly: "Thank you, Master, for saving your life. I am penniless and have no treasure to repay."
Lu waved his hand, without leaving his name, turned around and planned to leave. Doing good deeds without asking for anything in return is precisely the key condition for the system to determine conscience rewards.
The moment he turned around, crisp system prompts sounded in his mind one after another. 【bite! The host saw injustice and took action to rescue the oppressed innocent disciples. He did not ask for any reward and punished the followers without resorting to lynching. This was in line with the judgment of conscience and triggered a low-level conscience critical attack! 】【Merit +126, the residual bad luck of heaven in the body has been greatly washed away again, and the smoothness of practice has been improved again! 】【Scattered goodwill word-of-mouth began to take root in the hearts of nearby outer sect disciples, and the seeds of breaking one-sided prejudice sprouted again. 】
A group of outer disciples who were watching nearby witnessed the whole process with their own eyes. The previously deep-rooted stereotypes quietly cracked open. Many people secretly muttered: the rumors were completely different from what they saw with their own eyes. The evil young man who was reviled by the entire Internet came to save people. Senior Brother Su, who was sought after by thousands of people, allowed his men to hurt people at will. Sporadic doubts quietly took root in the hearts of the crowd, but due to the interference of heaven, no one dared to express their thoughts in public.
Lu Yan did not stay long, bid farewell to the crowd of onlookers, and quickly turned back towards the meeting hall. Just halfway through, Zhao Xiaopang, who had been waiting for a long time, ran towards him in a panic and said urgently: "Master, something happened! Su has already asked for the elixir in front of all the elders. The three supporting elders took turns speaking. Many elders are already interested, and the resource allocation is about to be finalized!"
Lu Yan's eyes narrowed, and he quickened his pace to rush to the main hall. Before he could step into the hall door, a new system prompt suddenly popped up. [Urgent information: After Su obtained the elixir resources, he immediately set off to the Black Wind Valley in the western suburbs to seize the opportunity of natural spiritual grass. The spiritual grass contained purified spiritual energy and was an excellent treasure for quickly breaking through in cultivation. It was an unjust opportunity given by heaven and was the next key target of checks and balances. 】
